Keep all existing keymaps, sources, and configurations intact, and verify the change with headless Neovim."

---

### Option 2: Short & Concise

> "Please enable ghost text completion in `blink.cmp` inside my `~/.config/nvim/init.lua` by configuring `completion.ghost_text = { enabled = true }` in its setup options without altering any other settings."
